raw_tokens.value: A raging giant stalker can take a
action to erupt into a violent or vulgar display directed at

within 60 feet. This display is infused with secret magical traditions that draw upon the Mammoth Lords' ancestral enmities toward giants. A targeted giant must succeed at a Will save (DC %1) or be compelled to focus its attacks on the giant stalker; this ability can also affect non-giant creatures that are Large or larger, though such creatures gain a +4 bonus on the Will save to resist the effect. This compulsion ends if the giant stalker is out of sight or inaccessible to the giant's attacks. While baited, a giant is distracted and enraged by the insults-a giant stalker gains a +1 dodge bonus to her AC against any giant she has successfully baited. Once baited, a giant remains baited for %3 rounds, or until the giant stalker's rage ends (whichever comes first). If the giant stalker baits a different giant, any previously baited giant is no longer baited. A giant that successfully saves against baiting is immune to that giant stalker's giant baiter ability for 24 hours. This is a language-dependent mind affecting effect.|10+BarbarianLVL/2+CON|GiantBaiterACBonus|CON
